comment: Read from the source at tag v2.1.14 (commit 75e5f70), which is the installed build. Output 8 (SINE_OUTPUT) is configured in the constructor but never given a PortWidget and never written, so it has no line and no tag. The fade tail decays by one part in the sample rate per sample, a time constant of about a second, but the figure is derived rather than stored so no number is quoted. The maker's page describes only the knob and does not mention that the FADE jack adds to it in volts.
